This didn't happen to me, but I was in the room when it did happen. Back in about March 2000, a friend of mine (male) got a call on his mobile (cell phone) from this elderly lady wanting to speak to her daughter. My friend informs her that she has the wrong number. She immediately starts screaming at him, demanding to know what he is doing with her daughter's phone. My friend calmly informs her that it is his phone, and that he has had the number for 3 years, and that the lady must be mistaken. She hangs up.

A few minutes later, my mate gets another call, this time it's the lady's husband. He wants to know what my friend has done with his daughter. He asks if my friend has kidnapped her / wants a ransom (I shit you not - we were both listening in and doing our best not to piss ourselves laughing at this point). Anyway, my friend keeps denying that he even knows their daughter, so they start threatening to get the police involved. My friend hangs up.

As far as I know, he never heard from the cops, but I like to think that the couple rang the police, reported their daughter kidnapped, gave my friend's mobile number as hers, only to learn that they'd dialled the wrong number. Judging by what I heard, I honestly believe they would think the cops were in on it.

Several years ago, I was at work one day and got a wrong number call on my cell. Answered it, told dude I wasn't who he was looking for, and hung up.

He then proceeded to call another 5-6 or so times over the next hour, each time went about the same, him asking for so and so and me repeating that I'm still not so and so. The last call I was pretty pissed and told him he needed to stop calling, then he started rambling about how he was in a hospital and I guess was kinda out of it in general, and kept trying to call his friend to come help but kept getting the number wrong.

He stopped calling after that. Not sure what happened after that, hope it worked out alright for the dude. He seemed like an ok (if not super out of it) dude.
